target: Run the real end-to-end acceptance matrix for the DMX-ORCH-INTEGRATION series after every live follow-up packet has landed, and emit the final VERIFIED proof bundle for the series
invariants: Final acceptance must NOT be claimed without real end-to-end evidence — bundle-level shape checks are insufficient
All TP-DMX-ORCH-{008..017} packets must advance from NOT_RUN to PASS per-packet codereview before this packet emits its proof
Live runs against ConPort, dope-memory, dope-context, the Python coordination API, the Kotlin task-orchestrator, and GitHub MUST occur in a controlled environment with explicit operator approval
Safety matrix (TX/TU/T6 refusal under live conditions) must produce zero false negatives
Authority audit must confirm no canonical-writer drift: no bridge surface acts as authority, no read surface mutates state
Supervisor Ledger acceptance remains external to this proof; ready_for_merge stays false until the ledger entry is recorded

commit.message: test(orchestrator): final DMX-ORCH integration acceptance proof

pr.title: test(orchestrator): final DMX-ORCH integration acceptance proof
pr.body: Runs the full end-to-end acceptance matrix for the DMX-ORCH-INTEGRATION series. Depends on every live follow-up packet landing first. Emits the final READY_FOR_REVIEW proof bundle; final VERIFIED status is awarded only when the Supervisor Ledger records its acceptance entry. Gemini-led to keep implementation-author and acceptance-author separate.

steps.task: Verify every dependency packet (DOCS-001, PROOF-PERPACKET-001, 009-LIVE, 012-LIVE, 013-LIVE, 014A-UPSTREAM, 014B equivalent inside 012-LIVE, 015-TUI, 016-DAEMON) is merged on main and has a PASS codereview_status in its proof bundle.
validation: Preflight artifact lists each dependency packet, its merge SHA, and its codereview_status.result.
If any dependency is missing or not PASS, this packet refuses to advance to step 2.

steps.task: Implement tests/integration/orchestrator/test_e2e_acceptance.py that walks the full operator workflow: morning startup -> context refresh -> packet forge -> intake -> audit -> transition preview -> transition apply -> PR readiness -> PR comment. Each step exercises live (but controlled) services.
validation: Every step produces a deterministic JSON receipt.
Receipts are collected into a single matrix artifact for review.

steps.task: Implement tests/integration/orchestrator/test_safety_matrix.py that confirms every TX/TU/T6 capability refuses under live conditions, including dope-context.clear_index, force-push, and unknown external v3 tools.
validation: Matrix asserts deterministic refusal with non-empty error messages.
Zero false negatives (no TX/TU/T6 capability silently accepted).

steps.task: Implement tests/integration/orchestrator/test_authority_audit.py that programmatically confirms: ConPort is the only writer of structured decisions/progress, dope-memory is the only writer of chronicle receipts, dopetask is the only execution runtime, task-orchestrator is the only workflow-transition writer, dopecon-bridge is never the canonical writer, dope-context never mutates source truth.
validation: Audit ingests live receipts and emits a canonical_writer count per data class.
Audit fails with named offenders if any capability surface drifts.

steps.task: Write docs/03-reference/orchestrator-integration/final-acceptance.md documenting the final operator runbook, the acceptance gates, and the Supervisor Ledger handoff.
validation: Doc links to every dependency packet's proof bundle and PR.
Doc captures known UNKNOWNs that must persist after VERIFIED is recorded.

steps.task: Run scripts/orchestrator/run_final_acceptance.py to assemble the final proof bundle at proof/dmx-orch-integration/TP-DMX-ORCH-017-FINAL/PROOF.json with the full validations array (live exit codes), codereview/precommit status, e2e matrix snapshot, safety matrix snapshot, authority audit, residual_risks, and rollback_plan.
validation: Proof status is READY_FOR_REVIEW (not VERIFIED — Supervisor Ledger holds that authority).
ready_for_merge remains false; the Supervisor Ledger entry is the only path to VERIFIED.
